observations: Photo 0 shows a white plastic tank enclosed in a metal cage, mounted on a metal stand with four legs and cross-bracing.
Photo 1 shows the same tank from a different angle, revealing a red cap on top, a black outlet valve with a red handle at the bottom, and a gray panel on the side.

Photo 2 shows the tank outdoors on a concrete surface, with a green label and a warning label with hazard symbols on the side. The tank is on a metal stand, and the background includes a chain-link fence and vehicles.
All photos show the same item: a large white plastic tank with a metal cage and stand, consistent with an IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tank.
The tank has a red cap on top, a black outlet valve with a red handle, and a gray panel on the side with labels and hazard symbols.
The metal cage and stand appear to be galvanized steel.
The tank is not shown filled or in use; it is presented as a standalone unit.
